title: Epoch-push replies report the newest epoch a base ran or acked
goal: A re-targeted move is refused when any unrevoked base ran, or acked a lease for, a later epoch than the promoting standby's state, not only when the promoting standby did
acceptance: A committed test fails first: B runs epoch 3 renewing through D, the owner re-targets to C at epoch 4, and C (which never acked B) is refused with standby_behind
/kaji/epoch-push replies carry the newest coordinator epoch the base held a lease at or acked; an older peer without the field is treated as unknown and documented
Owner agreed the scope 2026-11-24 (new field in the /kaji/epoch-push reply)
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real coordinator state, keys and device evidence remain private.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix
escalation: Changes the /kaji/epoch-push reply contract: the owner agrees the scope before work starts
Never let two coordinators act, or copy context as authority, to make progress
